what: A Brazilian funk tracker: tamborzao, Volt Mix, 150, mandelao and brega funk. Eight synthesised baile kits, six breaks to chop, an 808 bass with glides, tools that write each kit's funk, funk grooves and 64 live effects. A fork of KAWA, in Portuguese, English or Spanish.
author: saulofilho
sounds: All synthesised by the firmware (kits, breaks, factory sounds); no recording is used. The recordings on the hub page (docs/audio) are made from this firmware.
